lines: Just an ordinary day, like any other
You suddenly stood up and said
"Let's go watch the stars tonight"
"You say something nice once in a while"
We all said that and laughed
Down a road without even a light
We walked along, giddy like fools
So the loneliness and anxiety I carried
wouldn't crush me
I looked up from the pitch-black world
The night sky seemed to rain down stars
When did it start, I wonder—
there I was, chasing after you
Please, I'm begging you
Hear me out, don't be shocked
By this longing of mine
"That's Deneb, Altair, Vega"
You point — the Summer Triangle
I remember, and look up at the sky
At last I've found her, Princess Orihime
But where is Prince Hikoboshi?
Now she's all alone
Right beside me, you're having fun
And I couldn't say a thing
The truth is, all along
I knew somewhere in my heart
Even if I found you
It will never reach you
No, don't cry
That's what I told myself
Acting tough, I was a coward
Pretending I didn't care
And yet
The pain piercing my chest kept growing
Ah, so this is what it means
to fall in love
What will you do? Say it
The voice inside me speaks
I want to be by your side
The truth is cruel
I didn't say it
I couldn't say it
We can never go back
To that summer day, the glittering stars
Even now I can recall it
Your smiling face, your angry face
I loved them all
It's strange, isn't it — I knew all along
A secret only I know, one you'll never know
Across the night, you in my distant memories
point at the sky
with an innocent voice
